subject: Declared resource maxima and exact source exemplars available
body: resource-bounds.json records per-stage maxima with exact metadata/source examples. Highest slot / distinct slots per unspecialized module: kernel texture31/22 sampler11/12 buffer31/31;vertex texture7/2 sampler7/2 buffer25/18;fragment texture31/22 sampler14/15 buffer20/21. Static typed arrays include texture16 and sampler8; array_ref has no fixed length. Conditional/nested declarations are not active bound counts; do not relax ABI checks solely from maxima.
